name: Lateral-lined sharpshooter
desc: Lateral-lined sharpshooter (Cuerna costalis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cuerna costalis, also known as the lateral-lined sharpshooter, is a species of insect in the leafhopper family, Cicadellidae. It is native to the Eastern half of the United States.
